title: Orbifold Quantum Cohomology
summary: Master’s research on the quantum cohomology of orbifolds, at the intersection of geometry and topology.
advisors: Prof. Dr. Lino Grama and Dr. Leonardo Cavenaghi

title: Special Lagrangian Manifolds via Examples
institution: International Center for Mathematical Sciences · Bulgarian Academy of Sciences
summary: An introduction to special Lagrangian submanifolds through concrete examples in complex Euclidean space and Calabi–Yau threefolds.
advisors: Prof. Dr. Ludmil Katzarkov and Prof. Dr. Lino Grama

title: Introduction to Symplectic Geometry
summary: Foundations of symplectic geometry, with a study of coadjoint orbits of SL(2, ℝ) and an introduction to generalized complex geometry.

title: Differential Forms and the Geometry of Surfaces
summary: Differential forms and Cartan’s moving-frame method, culminating in a proof of the Gauss–Bonnet theorem for surfaces.

title: Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning
summary: Applied research experience in deep learning, natural language processing, and deep neural networks.
